name: Is it possible to perfectly match any drywall texture?

mainEntity.name: Is it possible to perfectly match any drywall texture?

acceptedAnswer.text: Achieving a perfect match for any drywall texture is the goal, though the exactness can depend on several factors. These include the age of the original texture, the complexity of the pattern, and the skill of the applicator. While professional contractors strive for near-perfect results, older or highly customized textures may present more challenges. Professional expertise significantly increases the likelihood of a seamless blend.
acceptedAnswer.description: While professionals aim for a perfect match, the exactness can depend on the original texture's age, complexity, and the applicator's skill.
